title: What if I just watch half of the next episode?
scene: 看动画片到点，他谈条件、自己定规则。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: This is the last episode, and then the TV goes off.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: What if I just watch half of the next episode?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Half an episode isn't really a thing, buddy.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Just one more episode, and then I will turn it off myself.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You said the same thing last time, remember?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I will set a timer this time, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Okay, you can have five more minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then set the timer, and you can go.

variations: "episode" 换 "song"；"set a timer" 换 "count to fifty"。
